metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: QEFXAE crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group I m m m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C128 H262 Eu33 N24 O188 1+,C2 H3 O2 1-,72(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu4 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu5 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu7 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu8 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu1A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu2A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu3A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu4A (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu5A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu7A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu8A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu1B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu2B (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu3B (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu4B (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu5B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu7B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu8B (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu1C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu2C (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu3C (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu4C (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu5C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu7C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu8C (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu6H (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6I (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6J (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6K (Eu) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 106 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 0.763-5.566 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 16.19-176.75°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Eu33(EDTA)12(OAc)2(CO3)4(μ3-OH)36(μ5-OH)4(H2O)38]·OAc·approximately 70H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 36 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 μ5-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 38 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
